description: Search funding rounds (venture rounds, debt, grants, IPOs), newest announcement first. Costs $0.009 per record returned, drawn from your balance (every account starts with a free $1); a search that matches nothing is free. Page with `cursor`: pass back `next_cursor` exactly as returned; a null `next_cursor` means there are no more matches. Narrow with filters before raising `limit`. Each record gives the headquarters as `location` (the place as the source states it, often a city) and `country` (the country name), plus `country_code` (the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code). Coverage: funding rounds are complete from 2026-10-01, partial from 2026-09-22 to 2026-09-30, and only a few earlier rounds are held, so a company whose last round was before that returns none (an empty answer carries a `coverage` object saying so).

country.description: Headquarters country as a name or ISO code, such as US, United States or DE. Other text, such as a city, matches the stated place (the record's `location`).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `next_cursor`.

limit.description: Records per page, 1 to 100 (default 25). Each record returned is billed.

name: funding_search
title: Search Funding Rounds
